rows.what_the_ink_shows: Under the left bend of the interlinear guide, just before the A of As-tu, the mark is a tiny detached round speck. It has no tail, directional stroke or attachment to either guide or A, and lies above the text baseline among smaller background flecks. See crops/134-2_scan151_Qsow061.jpg.
rows.note: The visual evidence supports treating this isolated mark as a speck or accidental blot rather than an intentional punctuation character. Remove only its unsure-dot node; retain the insertion guide and all writing.

events.outcome: Compared the actual original node for an unsure dot with the enlarged guide region. The supplied second-model omission is supported by the isolated speck-like shape and position, so only that node is removed.
